messages:
elaine: Heads up: our onboarding sample app that streams structured events is failing for some customers using JSON mode + streaming. Error shows up mid-stream.
jun: Do you have an example payload/stream? usually it's either NDJSON vs single JSON confusion or chunk boundaries.
elaine: Minimal repro: model emits chunks where the top-level JSON isn't complete until the last chunk. Our SDK helper currently calls schema validation on every received event and crashes on partial JSON.
priya: Hmm that's bad. The helper was changed to be stricter to catch schema drift early, but we didn't account for streaming semantics.
elaine: Example stream (chunks):
1) `{"events": [\n  {"t": 1, "msg": "ok"}`
2) `,\n  {"t": 2, "msg": "done"}`
3) `\n]}`
If validator runs on chunk 1 it throws.
matt: Which SDK and language? We have slightly different streaming APIs across SDKs.
elaine: Python SDK helper from devex/examples/onboarding_stream.py. Stack trace points to helpers/streaming_validator.py line 38 where json.loads(buffer) is called on every feed.
jun: Okay. Short-term workaround for users: set helper flag stream_validate=false to disable mid-stream parsing. But we should ship a proper fix.
priya: Proposed design: Streaming validator should operate in 3 modes: "disable" (never validate), "complete" (validate once when stream ends), and "line" (NDJSON-style validate per newline-delimited object). Default for streaming clients should be "complete".
matt: Another variant: some apps want partial object validation for UX (e.g., show first event ASAP). We can add an opt-in incremental mode that only validates syntactic completeness of the current top-level object without running the full schema.
elaine: Implementation notes: keep a small ring buffer, try to detect top-level closure using a cheap brace/count heuristic before attempting json.loads. That avoids expensive attempts on each small chunk.
jun: Good: also ensure it's tolerant to strings with braces inside. Heuristic must ignore braces inside quotes. We can reuse our existing tokenizer used for logs.
priya: Tests: add unit tests splitting a valid JSON at random indices and assert no exception is raised until finalize(), and an NDJSON test with splits across newlines. Also add a performance test to ensure validation doesn't add >5% latency in streaming path.
matt: CI config: tag tests with @streaming to run on infra nodes. Also add integration test using the sample onboarding app that streams 1000 small events.
ci-bot: Note: test quota for streaming-heavy tests is limited on main CI. Consider running them in a separate pipeline.
elaine: I'll draft PR that introduces StreamingJsonGate in helpers, a default validate_mode="complete", and an option incremental_syntax_check=true.
jun: For backwards compatibility make sure the default behavior for non-streaming (batch) callers is unchanged.
priya: Docs: update SDK streaming guide pages and add a short troubleshooting section: common error messages like `JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string` and recommended mitigations.
matt: Assign reviews: @priya for design, @jun for implementation, @elaine for tests.
elaine: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/421 with transcript and suggested tests.
priya: Thanks. One more: some models produce a mix of NDJSON and top-level arrays (legacy). Add detection logic: if buffer contains "\n{" repeatedly, treat as NDJSON; if starts with "[" treat as array.
jun: Will include detection and a fallback to buffering up to 64KB before forcing a parse attempt.
elaine: Pushed a draft branch streaming-validator-wip. PR coming shortly.
ci-bot: New branch created by elaine: streaming-validator-wip.
matt: Great work. This will stop a bunch of onboarding churn.
